business_scope.primary_industry_name: Zinc Alloy Die-Casting and Tampo Printing of 1:18 Scale Car Replicas

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid (customary law, English common law heritage and French civil law heritage; Constitution of Vanuatu Articles 47 and 95)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: France-Vanuatu Bilateral Investment Promotion and Protection Agreement (signed 1994)
PACER Plus - Pacific Agreement on Closer Economic Relations Plus (in force 2020)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: International Companies Act [Cap. 220] (Act No. 32 of 1990 as amended); Companies and International Trusts (Beneficial Ownership) Act No. 16 of 2016, as extended by the Companies and International Trusts (Beneficial Ownership) (Amendment) Act No. 17 of 2020; Anti-Money Laundering and Countering Financing of Terrorism Act No. 10 of 2019 together with the AML/CFT Regulations and VFSC Codes of Practice; United Nations Act [Cap. 69]; Financial Dealers Act [Cap. 70] (licensing of registered agents).

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified true copy of the biometric page of the passport of each director, shareholder and beneficial owner
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public or passport-issuing authority in the individual's country of residence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization (Vanuatu is not a party to the 1961 Hague Apostille Convention; authentication through the Vanuatu Ministry of Foreign Affairs, International Cooperation and External Trade or a Vanuatu Honorary Consulate)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing or Certificate of Incumbency of any corporate shareholder or corporate director
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Companies registry or licensed corporate service provider in the corporate owner's jurisdiction of incorporation

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference letter and six-month bank statement evidencing source of funds and source of wealth of the beneficial owner
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Licensed commercial bank of the beneficial owner or shareholder

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Executed UBO Declaration and PEP/Sanctions Self-Certification on the VFSC-licensed registered agent's prescribed template
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Beneficial owner and the Vanuatu registered agent (co-signed; signature notarized)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Power of Attorney or engagement mandate appointing the Vanuatu registered agent and registered office provider
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Shareholders and directors, or their licensed notary public

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Registered agents, as reporting bodies under the Anti-Money Laundering and Countering Financing of Terrorism Act No. 10 of 2019, must apply risk-based customer due diligence before incorporation, identifying all beneficial owners holding 25% or more of shares or voting control, plus senior managing officials. Mandatory screening covers: (i) domestic and foreign politically exposed persons and their family members and close associates, triggering enhanced due diligence; (ii) the United Nations Consolidated List and domestic designations under the United Nations Act [Cap. 69]; (iii) OFAC SDN, EU, UK and Australian sanctions lists as a correspondent-banking overlay for USD and AUD payment rails; (iv) adverse media, regulatory enforcement and tax-integrity flags, including FATF increased-monitoring status of Vanuatu (June 2024). CDD records must be kept current and re-run within 30 days of any material change in ownership or risk profile.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) Companies e-Registry - direct filing through a VFSC-licensed Registered Agent (www.vfsc.vu)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Names must be in English or French and in Latin script; Bislama names are accepted at VFSC discretion when written in Latin script, and non-Latin script names require a phonetic Latin-script transliteration. The name must end with 'Limited', 'Ltd', 'Ltee', 'Limited Company' or the French statutory equivalents, and must not be identical or colourably similar to any name already on the registry, nor merely generic, misleading, scandalous or contrary to public policy.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Bank, Banking, Trust, Trustee, Insurance, Assurance, Reinsurance and other regulated financial-services words (require prior license or consent of the VFSC and/or sector regulator)
Government, Commonwealth, State, Crown, Ministry, Municipal, Authority (words implying official patronage)
United Nations, Red Cross, World Bank, IMF, University (international institutions and protected emblems)
Vanuatu, Port Vila, Luganville (words creating a false connection with the sovereign state or its subdivisions)
Any unduly restricted token appearing in the VFSC's published prohibited-name list
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon rejection, the applicant or its registered agent may file a written reconsideration request with the VFSC Registrar within 14 days, attaching evidence of legitimate business purpose and, where relevant, prior ministerial consent; the Registrar must issue an administrative decision within 5 business days. If the name is refused a second time, a formal administrative appeal lies to the Minister responsible for the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission, to be lodged within 28 days of the second refusal. Alternatively, the applicant may alter the proposed name, obtain the required prior approval for restricted tokens, or pay the extension fee to renew the reservation window.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Not permissible for the statutory registered office: an International Company must maintain a physical registered office in Vanuatu, in practice located at the premises of a VFSC-licensed registered agent in Port Vila or Luganville, staffed and open during business hours. No local director, local shareholder or local economic substance is required; the operational business (zinc alloy die-casting, tampo printing and global distribution of 1:18 scale replicas) may be carried out entirely outside Vanuatu.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Estimated at under 5% per annum for a low-risk collectibles-manufacturing IC with clean PEP and sanctions status; VFSC nonetheless retains authority to conduct unannounced inspections of the registered agent's premises and books, and foreign correspondent banks may require agent attestations and enhanced records.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market fee for AML/CFT onboarding of a low-risk collectibles manufacturer

Consular legalization of the identification and corporate attestation bundle by Vanuatu diplomatic or honorary consul services

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act No. 32 of 1992 (Cap 222), as amended; ss. 3-14 (incorporation, name, certificate), s. 25 (shares and no par value), s. 36 (registered office and registered agent); supplemented by the Companies Act [Cap 191] for general corporate principles not inconsistent with the International Companies Act.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) – International Companies Registry and Office of the Registrar of International Companies, Port Vila, Vanuatu
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Form IC-1 (Application for Registration) together with the executed Memorandum and Articles of Association and the Declaration of Compliance
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital applies to an International Company under Cap 222; the standard authorized capital is 1,000 shares with no par value. No capital escrow or bank deposit requirement is imposed by the VFSC at incorporation.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: BE IT RESOLVED, as the first resolution of the Board: 1. That the subscriptions for 1,000 shares of no par value set out in the Memorandum of Association are ratified, allotted, and issued to the named subscribers, with the agreed consideration treated as fully satisfied in the share register. 2. That the registered office maintained by the licensed registered agent at the Company's registered address in Port Vila, Vanuatu is adopted as the statutory registered office of the Company. 3. That the first named directors and corporate secretary are appointed to hold office until the next annual meeting. 4. That the Company's seal is adopted and the registered agent is authorized to execute all statutory filings and returns.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) – International Companies Registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a name reservation request through the VFSC e-portal or a licensed registered agent. The proposed name must end with 'Limited' or an approved abbreviation and must not be identical or deceptively similar to an existing Vanuatu company. Pay the reservation fee; the reservation is valid for 14 calendar days.
required_dossiers: Copy of the proposed Memorandum of Association
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is refused for similarity or prohibited character, submit a revised name promptly or appeal to the VFSC Registrar with written representations under the International Companies Act, s. 13.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Preparation and Execution of Memorandum and Articles
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Engage a VFSC-licensed agent to draft the Memorandum and Articles of Association. The subscriber(s) must execute the Memorandum and Articles in the presence of a witness or notary, and each first director and the corporate secretary must sign a consent to act. Beneficial-owner due diligence is completed before execution.
required_dossiers: Draft Memorandum and Articles of Association
Signed subscriber consent and witness certifications
Consent to act of each first director and secretary
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Defective execution is cured by re-execution or by a notarial rectification deed executed within five business days of the agent's query.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Application for Incorporation and Certificate of Registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC – International Companies Registry, Port Vila
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File Form IC-1 together with the executed Memorandum and Articles, a Declaration of Compliance signed by the registered agent, and the agent's consent. Pay the government filing fee of USD 300. Upon verification, the Registrar issues the Certificate of Incorporation under the VFSC seal.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the application is queried, file a corrective notice or an amended document within 14 days; a formal refusal may be appealed to the Supreme Court of Vanuatu within 21 days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Appointment of Registered Office and Registered Agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon incorporation, the Board confirms the registered office address in Vanuatu and the licensed registered agent. The registered office address is recorded on Form IC-1, and the agent maintains the statutory registers at that address in accordance with Cap 222, s. 36.
required_dossiers: Notice to VFSC of registered office address
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registered agent resigns, the Board must appoint a successor agent within 14 days and file notice with the VFSC; the outgoing agent must provide immediate records access.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: First Board Organization and Officer Appointments
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Convene the first board meeting or adopt a unanimous written resolution embodying the Pro-Forma First Board Resolution. Record share allotments in the share register, adopt the common seal, and authorize the opening of the corporate bank account supporting Swift Wire and PayPal payment rails.
required_dossiers: First board meeting minutes or written resolutions
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Irregular resolutions are ratified by a subsequent board resolution within 30 days; any filing defect is cured through a supplemental filing.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC; Provincial Government Council; Vanuatu Investment Promotion Authority (VIPA)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the annual return within the required calendar cycle and obtain the provincial business licence under the Business Licence Act before physical manufacturing begins. Complete the DEPC environmental screening questionnaire in advance of installing zinc die-casting and tampo-printing equipment.
required_dossiers: Payment of licence and permit fees
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Late-filing penalties are paid and a reinstatement application is submitted; environmental screening findings may be escalated or reduced with accompanying technical justification.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Vanuatu Investment Promotion Authority (VIPA) and the relevant Provincial Government Council under the Business Licence Act [Cap 179]; policy oversight by the Department of Industry, Ministry of Trade, Tourism, Industry and Commerce
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Manufacturing Business Licence – Zinc Die-Casting and Metal Model Fabrication (Category M-3)

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Department of Environmental Protection and Conservation (DEPC), Ministry of Climate Change, Adaptation, Meteorology, Geo-Hazards, Energy, Environment and National Disaster Management
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category B – Preliminary Environmental Assessment (PEA) required before commissioning the die-casting line; escalation to full Category A EIA is triggered if the facility discharges metal-bearing effluent above prescribed thresholds or processes more than 5 tonnes of zinc per month.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Compliance with the Environmental Protection and Conservation Act [Cap 283] and DEPC discharge thresholds: no untreated process-water discharge; zinc concentration in effluent below 5 mg/L or on-site zero-discharge recirculation; tampo ink solvent (VOC) emissions controlled by fume extraction and monthly mass-balance records; die-casting flux residues stored in sealed containers and removed by a DEPC-licensed waste contractor.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety clearance from the Vanuatu Police Force Fire Services (extinguishing systems, evacuation plan, and segregated storage for flammable tampo inks); structural load inspection by the Public Works Department for die-casting machinery footings and lifting equipment; occupational workplace clearance from the Department of Labour covering machine guarding, PPE, emergency eye-wash stations, and occupational noise monitoring.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Vanuatu Customs and Inland Revenue Department (VCIRD), Ministry of Finance and Economic Management; taxpayer portal: VCIRD Revenue Online Services (VROLS).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign entity must first appoint a registered Vanuatu agent and obtain an International Company (IC) registration certificate from the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC). The IC then files TIN application Form TIN-01 with VCIRD, attaching the VFSC certificate, certified passport copies of directors/ultimate beneficial owners, a local agent appointment affidavit, and proof of registered office. VCIRD issues the TIN within five business days. VAT registration is captured on the same form where projected annual taxable turnover exceeds the statutory threshold; no income tax registration is required because Vanuatu levies no corporate income tax.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Vanuatu has no check-the-box or hybrid mismatch election regime. An International Company may voluntarily elect to be converted to a resident company under the Companies Act, which does not create income tax exposure given the absence of direct taxation; however, conversion subjects the entity to Vanuatu VAT, customs duties, and local business compliance obligations. No standalone election to be taxed as a partnership or disregarded entity exists in Vanuatu domestic law.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: VAT (Value Added Tax Act No. 24 of 2019, effective 1 July 2020)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Vanuatu does not currently mandate real-time fiscal clearance, continuous transaction controls, or a government API electronic invoicing gateway. VAT-registered suppliers issue an invoice containing the statutory VAT invoice particulars; no digital stamping or pre-clearance approval is required by VCIRD at present.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Goods physically removed from Vanuatu by the IC for supply to an overseas customer within six months of the invoice date qualify for VAT zero-rating. Die-cast and tampo-printed scale models sold FOB or under CIF Incoterms to non-resident buyers are zero-rated provided the supplier retains credible evidence of export and foreign counterpart settlement. Commissionaire/external sales-agent arrangements remain zero-rated when title and risk pass outside Vanuatu.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Vanuatu Customs Form VDE/7 as per Customs Act Cap. 250)
Bill of Lading or House Airway Bill evidencing despatch from Vanuatu
Inward Remittance Certificate / SWIFT credit advice or bank statement showing non-resident payment settlement
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: VCIRD may audit zero-rating claims within five years of assessment. Where the export substantiation bundle is incomplete or the payment is not received within the six-month benchmark, the zero-rated treatment is disallowed and output VAT becomes payable together with interest at 12% per annum and a late-payment penalty of up to 75% of the VAT undercharged. Deliberate fraudulent claims are subject to clawback of refunds, civil fines up to 200% of the amount involved, and imprisonment in aggravated cases.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Reserve Bank of Vanuatu (RBV), established under the Reserve Bank of Vanuatu Act (Cap 125), acting as the sole monetary authority, issuer of the Vatu, and the administrator of the Exchange Control Act (Cap 69). The Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) regulates the International Company form under the International Companies Act 1992, but holds no FX regulatory authority.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Vanuatu has accepted IMF Article VIII obligations and operates a managed floating currency regime with the VUV anchored to a trade-weighted basket dominated by AUD, USD, NZD and EUR. Current-account international payments are effectively unrestricted under the general permissions granted to authorised dealers (ADs), covering import settlement, trade finance, service fees and legitimate profit remittance. Capital-account movements, including equity injections, intercompany lending and structured hedging, are permitted but attract documentary verification by the AD and, for significant VUV conversions, may require RBV capital-transfer endorsement against the bank's open-position limits. A Vanuatu International Company pays no income tax, capital gains tax or withholding tax under the International Companies Act; therefore the only operative remittance barrier is commercial-bank documentary gatekeeping: audited or compiled financial statements, board minutes approving the remittance, up-to-date beneficial ownership declarations and, where applicable, confirmation from the Vanuatu Revenue Authority of nil taxable status.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: The Exchange Control Act (Cap 69) requires export proceeds to be repatriated within six months from the date of exportation and either offered for sale to an authorised dealer or credited to an approved foreign-currency External Account. Vanuatu imposes no fixed percentage surrender requirement and no mandatory conversion ratio for export receipts. A Vanuatu International Company acting as a cross-border trading and treasury vehicle may retain 100% of USD export sales proceeds in a bank-designated External Account, provided the AD holds on file: the export customs declarations, bills of lading, commercial invoices, underlying procurement contracts with the die-casting foundries, and a board resolution authorising foreign-currency retention. For non-resident ICs with no Vanuatu-source activities, the retention approval is routinely granted without RBV referral.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Account (multi-currency USD/VUV) as an External Account plus segregated Capital Escrow Account for paid-up share capital and shareholder loan injections
Operational Account / Foreign-Currency USD Settlement Account and LC-backed Escrow Account for trade disbursements
Capital Escrow Account / local VUV Operational Account; secondary clearing bank for domestic payment obligations
Operational Account / multi-currency EUR-USD-VUV account suited to European collector-market settlements
Operational Account for small-ticket International Company treasury flows

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: LOW-MEDIUM and strictly ancillary. Offshore electronic-money institutions (EMIs) such as Airwallex, Wise, Payoneer and Revolut Business are not licensed deposit-taking institutions in Vanuatu, cannot hold VUV, and do not issue Vanuatu-based account identifiers. They may be used as secondary collection and FX-conversion rails for B2C card flows and for payer-side USD remittances, but every EMI transaction must ultimately settle through the primary SWIFT-enabled corporate account at ANZ or BSP. PayPal Business serves only as a B2C card-acquirer rail, not a bank; Vanuatu ICs may onboard PayPal where supported, yet PayPal will typically apply rolling 60-day reserve logic to high-value 'die-cast collectibles' sales and will require a verified linked bank account, product evidence and brand-licensing documentation. To protect the treasury, PayPal and EMI volumes should be capped below 15% of monthly collections and never used for foundry supplier disbursements.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: In-person onboarding is effectively mandatory at tier-1 Vanuatu banks. At least one natural-person director or authorised signatory, normally the licensed registered agent in Port Vila, and every beneficial owner holding more than 10% of the International Company must attend a face-to-face KYC interview at the bank branch or before a VFSC-accredited fiduciary. Remote video-KYC may be accepted only for secondary beneficial owners whose identities are separately certified by a licensed corporate-services provider. Documents must be produced in original or apostilled certified-copy form: passport, certificate of incorporation, constitutional documents, registered-agent certificate, board resolution resolving to open the account, extract of the Beneficial Ownership Register, bank references, and source-of-wealth statements for the die-casting trade. Fully remote electronic onboarding is not available; the fallback is a two-day Port Vila fiduciary-hosted interview with couriered original documents.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Beneficial ownership opacity created by nominee directors and nominee shareholders under a Vanuatu International Company structure
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Registered-agent certificate issued by a VFSC licensee; completed Beneficial Ownership Register identifying all ultimate natural persons; director nomination deed; source-of-wealth statement for trade capital; third-level corporate-organisation chart; annual government-fee payment receipts evidencing good standing; signed undertaking to update the register within 14 days of any change.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-frequency USD wire flows to PRC and Hong Kong zinc-alloy foundries and tampo-printing workshops, triggering high-risk jurisdiction and trade-corridor screening
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Executed supply and tooling agreements with the foundries; proforma invoices and purchase orders referencing 1:18 scale model SKUs; customs export declarations, bills of lading and air waybills; supplier business-licence translations; 12-month three-way reconciliation of purchase orders, goods-receipt records and payment instructions; bank reference letters from the supplier's settlement bank.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Trade-based money-laundering suspicion arising from mismatches between declared collectible values and consolidated remittance size on B2C card rails
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Brand-licence agreements from automotive OEM trademark holders and scale-model brand owners authorising tampo-printed artworks; per-SKU commercial pricing catalogue; certificate of origin and HS 9503.00 export classification; independent appraisal of representative die-cast units; CPA-prepared export-invoice log reconciling quantities, unit prices and freight charges.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Insufficient economic substance and CRS/FATCA non-cooperation flags due to zero local employees and absence of physical premises
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Registered-office certificate issued by the licensed agent; CRS self-certification with tax identification statement evidencing tax-exempt status under the International Companies Act 1992; board minutes demonstrating that treasury decisions are taken in Vanuatu; audited or compiled financial statements; annual agent-filed return evidencing the maintained beneficial-ownership register.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Shareholder equity and intercompany capital injections must be transmitted by SWIFT MT103 from the investor's banking relationship to the IC's designated USD External Account at ANZ or BSP. The wire narrative must expressly state 'Paid-up capital contribution – Vanuatu International Company – working capital for zinc alloy die-casting operations'. The AD will require the corporate documents, board resolution approving the capital increase, shareholder register extract, incumbency certificate, CRS self-certification and a source-of-funds statement. Inbound funds are held in the Capital Escrow Account for a compliance clearance period of up to five business days before being released for supplier disbursements. VUV-denominated capital injections above the AD's delegated limit require prior RBV clearance and are converted at the daily RBV reference rate; therefore the treasury should route all material injections in USD or AUD to preserve flexibility.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: The primary clearing rail is SWIFT MT103 for pre-production deposits, milestone payments against purchase orders, and final settlement against shipping documents to Chinese die-casting and tampo-printing suppliers. For large monthly production batches the recommended rail is a Commercial Letter of Credit issued by ANZ/BSP Vanuatu in favour of the supplier, at sight or up to 90 days, with documents comprising commercial invoice, packing list, full set of bills of lading, certificate of origin and independent pre-shipment inspection certificate. USD clearing is executed through the AD's London or Sydney Nostro accounts; VUV clearing is restricted to the Vanuatu domestic interbank settlement system and should not be used for trade payables. PayPal and EMI card collections are swept monthly into the master USD account with a two-day reconciliation buffer to align incoming settlement with outgoing foundry disbursements and reduce idle float.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Spot FX contract with an onshore authorised dealer (ANZ, BSP or BRED) executed against the RBV-published daily USD/VUV reference rate
Outright deliverable USD/VUV forward up to 12 months, supported by underlying die-casting trade invoices and collateralised at 20% to 40% of notional
Cross-currency swap (USD/VUV or AUD/VUV) booked back-to-back with the offshore parent treasury, subject to documented trade exposure and RBV capital-transaction approval

Non-deliverable VUV forward (NDF) transacted through Hong Kong or Singapore dealing rooms, permissible where onshore conversion creates illiquidity and the hedge is backed by a genuine commercial receivable

Vanuatu-licensed FX option structures on USD/VUV used strictly to hedge forecast supplier payments and collector-market receipts, supported by underlying sales contracts and the Financial Dealers Act 2011 dealing licence

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before the anniversary of registration each year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late penalty accrues at 10% per month from the due date; the company may be struck off after six months of non-payment.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) via licensed Registered Agent
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 30 days after each anniversary date
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure may result in a warning, administrative penalty, or agent resignation leading to administrative strike-off.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Not applicable for Vanuatu International Companies; no statutory audit required regardless of turnover or assets.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: No mandatory local GAAP; books may be maintained in any recognized format and jurisdiction; IFRS recommended for voluntary financial reporting.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: No annual UBO confirmation filing is mandated; beneficial ownership records must be kept current and updated within 21 days of any shareholding transfer or relevant change.

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 0% — Vanuatu levies no corporate income tax on any company; International Companies (ICs) under the International Companies Act Cap. 222 are statutorily exempt from all income, profits, capital gains and distribution taxes.
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Effective tax burden: 0%. No tax holidays or preferential deductions exist because the baseline rate is nil. Recurring state charges are limited to the annual VFSC government fee (approximately USD 300–500 depending on authorized capital) and the licensed registered agent fee; municipal business license fees arise only if physical commercial activity is conducted inside Vanuatu.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: VFSC Annual Return (Form AR/IC) — statutory annual return for International Companies, filed by the licensed Vanuatu registered agent through the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) E-Registry portal.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Filed within 30 days after each anniversary of incorporation; the annual VFSC government fee is payable in advance on the anniversary date.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Exact legal name of the IC and VFSC registration number as per Certificate of Incorporation.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident directors must confirm the legal name exactly matches bank and PayPal settlement records to avoid rejected wire transfers.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Registered office address in Vanuatu (physical street address of the licensed agent; a PO Box alone is invalid).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Use the agent's physical address; no notarization is required for this field.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Name and licence number of the Vanuatu registered agent.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The agent attests; a non-resident cannot self-appoint or appoint a foreign law firm as agent.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Authorized capital and issued shares: class, par value and currency.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Common default is 1,000 shares of USD 1; 100% non-resident ownership is permitted and minimum capital is not required.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Full names, nationalities, residential addresses and appointment dates of all directors.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Each non-resident director must supply a certified passport copy and proof of residential address to the agent for the AML file.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Shareholders and ultimate beneficial owners: name, address, shareholding and source of funds.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Beneficial ownership must be disclosed under Vanuatu AML/CFT requirements; bearer shares are prohibited.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declaration of exempt offshore status: no business with Vanuatu residents, no landholding in Vanuatu, no regulated financial activity.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: False declarations trigger criminal liability; export sales of die-cast models shipped directly to foreign buyers do not breach the declaration.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Signature of a director or authorized officer, capacity and date.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Remote execution is acceptable; the agent countersigns; a certified power of attorney must be attached if signed by an attorney.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: VFSC late-filing surcharge assessed per month or part-month on the annual duty; automatic late-payment penalty on the government fee; continued default triggers administrative strike-off from the International Companies Register; restoration requires a VFSC or Court application and payment of all arrears; directors face fines up to VT 100,000 for non-filing without reasonable excuse.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Vanuatu VAT Return (Form 100) — indirect tax return filed through the Vanuatu Department of Customs and Inland Revenue (DCIR) portal; mandatory only where the IC makes taxable supplies in Vanuatu. A compliant offshore IC with zero local sales has no VAT filing obligation.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Monthly or quarterly per DCIR taxpayer classification
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Monthly returns due by the end of the following calendar month; quarterly returns due within 15–20 days after the end of the quarter.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Value of taxable supplies in Vanuatu and output VAT at 12.5%.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Offshore IC with no local sales enters nil; do not include export sales of die-cast models shipped directly by the foreign manufacturer to foreign customers.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Creditable input VAT on Vanuatu-incurred purchases.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident ICs may reclaim VAT only on local inputs; retain supplier VAT invoices and customs import documents.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Net VAT payable or refundable (Box A minus Box B).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A refund position triggers a DCIR risk review; ensure supporting bills of lading and commercial invoices are available.
Declare warehousing or freight services supplied to foreign principals as zero-rated; maintain written contracts evidencing the foreign recipient.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Penalty of 10% of the VAT under-declared plus monthly interest at 2%; additional 25% penalty for fraudulent or negligent returns; Customs may detain goods imported for local supply; the VAT registration number may be deregistered.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% — Vanuatu imposes no dividend withholding tax; an International Company may distribute profits to non-resident shareholders free of domestic tax.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: No DTA relief is available because Vanuatu has no comprehensive double tax treaty network. The administrative protocol for non-resident shareholders requiring proof of tax status is: (i) instruct the registered agent to apply to the VFSC for a Certificate of Tax Exemption / Tax Residency Certificate; (ii) attach the certificate of incorporation, current annual return filing receipt and a board resolution identifying the shareholder; (iii) the certificate is issued within 5–10 business days upon payment of the gazetted fee; (iv) forward the certificate to the foreign tax authority. Because no Vanuatu tax was actually paid, foreign tax credit relief is generally unavailable; the certificate primarily evidences the IC's exempt status and Vanuatu residence.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Royalties: statutory 0% (no domestic royalty WHT); treaty 0% (no DTA). Interest: statutory 0%; treaty 0%. Outbound payments to IP licensors and lenders are not subject to Vanuatu tax. Monitoring requirement: the foreign recipient's source country may apply outbound WHT (e.g., US portfolio interest rules, EU royalty withholding) and CFC/anti-hybrid rules must be separately tested.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: No statutory threshold exists in Vanuatu because no transfer-pricing, Local File or Master File legislation has been enacted. Practical compliance benchmark recommended for international tax audits: prepare OECD-compliant documentation where the IC's annual related-party transactions (e.g., purchases of zinc alloy castings, tampo printing services and packaging from affiliated producers) exceed VUV 50,000,000 (approximately USD 420,000), and align with the parent group's Country-by-Country Reporting threshold of consolidated revenue equal to or greater than EUR 750,000,000.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Vanuatu has not enacted formal Economic Substance Regulations in the style of BVI/Cayman. Nevertheless, VFSC practice and OECD Global Forum evaluations require the IC to prove real economic presence proportionate to its die-cast trading activity: (i) a physical office in Vanuatu (a PO Box address is insufficient); (ii) a licensed resident agent maintaining client records; (iii) board meetings held or recorded in Vanuatu; (iv) local employees and expenditure commensurate with turnover; (v) full accounting records retained in Vanuatu. Failure to substantiate these elements creates a presumption of a shell company, exposes the IC to strike-off, loss of the Certificate of Tax Exemption and inclusion on adverse foreign jurisdiction lists.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Offshore Shell Company / Lack of Economic Substance
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: The IC maintains no physical office, employee, accounting record or active decision-making in Vanuatu while manufacturing, purchasing and selling 1:18 scale die-cast models through PayPal and SWIFT from foreign management; the entity functions purely as a booking vehicle.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: No formal ESR penalty exists in Vanuatu law, but VFSC scrutiny leads to denial or revocation of the Certificate of Tax Exemption, compulsory conversion to domestic company status, administrative strike-off and publication on adverse jurisdiction registers; foreign counterparts simultaneously deny treaty or credit benefits.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors cannot rely on limited liability where they knowingly file the annual offshore declaration falsely; they face personal fines, director disqualification orders and criminal liability for false statutory declarations.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failure to perform customer due diligence on distributors and PayPal beneficiaries, failure to file suspicious transaction reports with the Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit (VFIU), or using the IC to route payments from sanctioned jurisdictions.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under the Vanuatu AML/CFT legislation: administrative fines up to VT 50,000,000 or a percentage of turnover for systemic breaches; VFSC may suspend or revoke the registered agent's licence; correspondent banks, SWIFT intermediaries and PayPal may terminate the IC's accounts.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Individuals convicted of money laundering or terrorist financing offences face substantial criminal fines and imprisonment of up to 15 years; travel bans, asset-freezing orders and extradition cooperation apply.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: VFSC Registration and Annual Return Default
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Late or non-filing of the annual return, non-payment of the VFSC government fee, or failure to notify the Registrar of changes to directors, shareholders or registered office.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Automatic late-filing surcharge, interest on unpaid annual duty, administrative strike-off from the International Companies Register; assets held in the company's name may be administratively dealt with after dissolution; restoration requires a court order and payment of all arrears.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: A director who continues to trade knowing the company is in default and liable to be struck off is personally liable for debts incurred after that knowledge; VFSC may also ban directors from managing any Vanuatu company.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Fraudulent Trading and Piercing the Corporate Veil
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Diverting collections receivable via PayPal or SWIFT wire into personal accounts, carrying on business to defraud creditors, or issuing false commercial invoices and import declarations for die-cast scale model consignments.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under the International Companies Act and Vanuatu Companies Act: civil restitution orders, director disqualification, winding-up on just and equitable grounds, fines for fraudulent accounting, and compulsory asset repatriation.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Courts may impose full personal liability for company debts, issue travel bans and arrest warrants, and prosecute fraud and false accounting offences carrying imprisonment; banking and PayPal accounts may be frozen under court order.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Unregistered Cross-Border Indirect Taxes (EU IOSS / AU GST / US Sales Tax)
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Distance-selling finished 1:18 die-cast models into the EU without IOSS VAT registration, into Australia without GST registration, or into US states without sales tax economic nexus registration; additionally understating customs value on courier consignments and using PayPal settlement addresses that expose the beneficial owner.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Source-country assessments: EU VAT at 20–27% with penalties up to 50% of tax due; Australian GST assessments and penalties; US state sales tax back assessments; customs detention and destruction of goods; PayPal, eBay and Amazon marketplace payment holds and deemed-supplier liability on marketplaces.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Customs offences are criminalized in destination countries; directors who knowingly sign false commercial invoices face personal imprisonment for customs fraud and personal liability for import VAT and penalties.
